svg.title: KIRA AI implementation workflow
svg.desc: AI-focused architecture showing multimodal input, Qwen reasoning orchestrated by LangGraph, five KIRA specialist intelligence systems, grounded data, human approval, and user-facing outcomes.

g.text: How KIRA understands, reasons, delegates, predicts and turns AI decisions into trusted user actions
Loads financial snapshot, active goals, conversation
and long-term preferences before the model reasons
Specialist evidence returns to Qwen until the request is complete
Detects anomalies, unfunded bills and future buffer risk · compares past advice with actual behavior
Nightly personalized guidance → user response → stronger behavior profile
GROUNDED BY · confirmed finance data · user memory · maps/routing · live job boards
Ready to add to the day
Conversation → context → Day Planner AI → grounded ranking
→ suitable place, price, route and alternatives
Conversation → Goal Agent → plan + scenario reasoning
Goal context → dynamic job search → Work Recommender AI
→ top 3 matches + income/date effect + apply action
